what_happened: Kernel-evaluated probe settled option 3 in one elaboration pass: 10 decide-level results, zero sorries, standard axioms. posAtFull measured against posAt/liveAt at five landed certificates.

Task description's premise -- 'full labels make posAt a singleton so no junk position could exist' -- is refuted as stated: posAtFull Fixture.cert (-1) is a 2-element set unequal to liveAt (-1), so a dead full-label position exists. The premise holds only for embedded certificates, where it is a property of the embedding rather than of the label refinement.

The research report's R3 recommends landing three probe theorems into EmbedComplete.lean but says nothing about the fate of the probe file itself. scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh's own header states the governing doctrine: a probe recording a design obstruction must live under specs/evidence/ (tracked, task-independent) and be WIRED before the producing task is archived, because /todo moves task directories to specs/archive/, which .gitignore excludes. probes/FullLabels.lean is currently tracked but task-sited, so archival would silently drop the option-3 refutation from version control. The plan adds a promotion-and-wiring phase to close this.

The research round left every quantity this plan needs already measured at decide level in a sorry-free probe, so planning required no new Lean measurement: the three embedded-route equalities the plan promotes are copied verbatim from probes/FullLabels.lean Parts C/D, with their working maxRecDepth/maxHeartbeats envelope already established. Planning also reused the lean4 plan-authoring gate-collision checklist to pre-authorize the typst/generated/status.typ and module-inventory regeneration steps rather than discovering them at commit time.
